name: baseline.create
title: Create baseline
summary: Write a baseline file for a selection (SR-050, ADR-0018): name, date, the HEAD commit of every repository involved, ID and version (in normal form n2, ADR-0005) of every element. Refused while files of the selection are not committed. Never commits, never replaces a baseline.
whileReadOnlyReason: Stores the current versions of the selection, which depend on the metamodel (which properties count).

selection.description: Stored in the file: a saved filter as its where and view, package and view with their title. Not baseline.

output.description: Errors: baseline.exists when a baseline has the name, ignoring case and Unicode normal form (details.file, details.repository: its file; nothing written, SR-050 AK6); a taken file name gets -2, -3, …; baseline.uncommitted-changes (details.elements[] {id, repository, file}, details.files[] {repository, file}; SR-050 AK2); git.unavailable when a repository involved is not under Git or has no commit (details.repository; AK7); file.faulty when a selected element has no version (details.elements[]); input.invalid for selection.baseline, and for selection.view when it names another view than the saved filter (spec question #440); file.faulty when the baselines folder cannot be listed (details.repository, details.file); input.invalid with details.reason git-folder (details.repository, details.file, details.rule, details.path) when the baselines folder meets Git: a name taken for .git, a folder with a .git entry or a link into .git, also where the workspace file places it (D-036). The baseline is never replaced afterwards.

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root, / as separator.

file.description: The file, relative to the workspace root, / as separator.

repository.description: The repository that holds the file; `repository` in the file is relative to it.

elements.description: Number of elements in the file.

incomplete.description: A repository is not here, so the view may miss a replacement or exclusion stored there (SR-006); the file is written all the same, with a warning.
